title: Tech Note: Connecting to a 4D Server

historical_commentary.text: The 4D Open plug-in and the specific connection mechanism it describes are obsolete; modern 4D applications connect to remote 4D Servers using built-in remote mode / client-server architecture and, for programmatic cross-database access, ORDA remote datastores, none of which require a separate connectivity plug-in as in 2003.
related_updates: 4D's native client-server architecture and ORDA remote datastores have superseded the 4D Open plug-in for connecting to remote 4D Servers
